items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers the failed indoor heating pipe. Section 7.1.9 limits the designer replacement to the cost of plain copper: 6.4 m × €15.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow the standard copper fittings without the chrome premium: 4 × €10.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow standard copper equivalents: 5 × €20, with no allowance for the chrome finish.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow one standard copper equivalent at €20, excluding the chrome premium.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers minor repair fasteners. The eight screws are valued at €1.10 each.
The 10 mm clamps do not match the documented 15 mm or 28 mm repair dimensions and are likely excluded under §7.1.8(e). If shown to serve the repair, four at €5 each would total €20.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers repair fixings. The matching Case 40 line supports about €25 for all four clamps.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary trade labour. No separate upgrade labour is identified, so the estimate uses the full 6.75 invoiced hours at about €88 per hour.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers repair labour. The matching Case 40 prior gives about €418 for the full 5.75 hours at roughly €73 per hour.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 limit reinstatement to the original rock-wool specification. Six standard shells at €20 each total €120.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers installation consumables used for the repair. The prior values the full 2 kg at €9.80 per kg.
Section 7.1.9 excludes the sensor because it was not present before the loss. The conditional estimate is €125 for one app-connected unit.
Section 7.1.9 excludes the valve because it is a new addition, not a replacement. The conditional estimate is €180 for one valve.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e) allow minor repair consumables billed as a lump sum. The prior values the single charge at €36.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge per contractor per invoice. This is the only charge, valued at €79.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of debris from the failed pipe repair. The matching Case 40 range is €58–€61 for one charge.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes separately billed processing charges. The conditional estimate for one fee is €25.
